title: An Act to Amend the Education Laws Regarding the State Board of Education's Authority Concerning Degree-granting Institutions

summary.text: This bill exempts from the laws governing degree-granting educational institutions educational institutions that operate a branch or extension campus in this State that is affiliated with a nonprofit educational institution operating in another state that meets certain criteria. This exemption applies only to such a branch or extension campus.

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Secretary of the Senate on December 9, 2025 and REFERRED to the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURAL AFFAIRS pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2
